name: Idol Kanojo ~Futari dake no Himitsu Lesson~
original_name: アイドル彼女～ふたりだけの秘密レッスン～
source:
The name on everyone's lips these days was super popular "Oto Musume".
Last summer her star had risen and she was a big hit, releasing song after song.
I'd always loved her, and was glad to see her mainstream success... but...
I don't know how, all of a sudden I went from being her fan to her lover!
Or first date we jumped straight in the sack.
She was even more alluring in person than on television. So cute, so stylish, and her breasts...!
She had the perfect performance ability, cosplayed as a maid, was my "little sister" in swimwear, china dress, whatever I requested.
She was spontaneous and just dumb enough to fall in love with me! My life is like a dream!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE098139.html]DLsite English[/url]]
